_comment: Provenance of the LPOSS propagation executed by scripts/pm_stage8_lposs.py. Regenerate with scripts/lposs_provenance.py; verify against upstream with --lposs /path/to/LPOSS.

upstream.paper: Stojnic, Kalantidis, Matas, Tolias. LPOSS: Label Propagation over Patches and Pixels for Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation. CVPR 2025.

digest_definition: SHA-256 over the function's source lines as written; sha256_rstrip is the same text with trailing whitespace stripped (the form our extractor emits, and the form to compare across files).

documented_deviations.where: scripts/pm_stage8_lposs.py (shim applied after import; the extracted module is never edited)
documented_deviations.why: prebuilt faiss GPU wheels ship no sm_90 kernels, so faiss.knn_gpu raises CUDA error 209 on an H100; faiss-cpu is used for the import only.
documented_deviations.effect: the shim returns the exact same k nearest neighbours by cosine similarity (torch.topk on the full similarity matrix), i.e. an exact rather than approximate kNN; it is not an algorithmic change to the propagation.

documented_deviations.what: logits and affinities come from this paper's cached dense-CLIP (SCLIP-CSA) stack and our five seen/novel splits, not from LPOSS's own pipeline
documented_deviations.why: the comparison isolates the propagation mechanism under a matched protocol.
documented_deviations.effect: the reported 15.1 mIoU is NOT LPOSS's published ADE20K number and no claim is made about LPOSS's own full-resolution system.
